about: Vehicles a character can ride (docs/design/05-frontend.md, "Crab Bike assets"). Speeds in m/s; the server allows speed times the tolerance in movement.json. Seat 0 is the rider (who must have the capability in requires and own the vehicle); seat 1 waits for ride-hailing. Ids are stable: archetypes and later items refer to them. xe_tap_lai is the driving school's bike, lent to a player on the A1 practical only (docs/design/13-driver.md).
